= Crypto (JCE)
:artifactid: camel-crypto-starter

Sign message bodies and verify their signatures with java.security.Signature of the Java Cryptography Architecture.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::crypto-component.adoc[Crypto (JCE) component], URI syntax: `crypto:cryptoOperation:name`
* xref:{csb-camel-components}:dataformats:crypto-dataformat.adoc[Crypto (Java Cryptographic Extension) data format]

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
